description: This source file contains unit tests for filesystem-related classes ('File' and 'Directory') in the WPEFramework core module. It tests file creation, reading, writing, moving, and directory navigation functionalities using Google Test framework.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Represents a filesystem file with operations for creation, opening, reading, writing, moving, and querying attributes.

classes.name: Directory
classes.description: Represents a filesystem directory with capabilities to create, traverse, and query directory contents.

methods.name: File::Create
methods.description: Creates the file, optionally with write permissions.

methods.name: File::Open
methods.description: Opens the file for I/O operations.

methods.name: File::Append
methods.description: Prepares file for appending data.

methods.name: File::Write
methods.description: Writes data to the file.

methods.name: File::Read
methods.description: Reads data from the file.

methods.name: File::SetSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the file.

methods.name: File::Destroy
methods.description: Deletes the file.

methods.name: File::Exists
methods.description: Checks if the file exists.

methods.name: File::IsReadOnly
methods.description: Checks if the file is read-only.

methods.name: File::IsHidden
methods.description: Checks if the file is hidden.

methods.name: File::IsSystem
methods.description: Checks if the file is a system file.

methods.name: File::IsArchive
methods.description: Checks if the file is an archive.

methods.name: File::IsDirectory
methods.description: Checks if the file path is a directory.

methods.name: File::IsLink
methods.description: Checks if the file is a symbolic link.

methods.name: File::IsCompressed
methods.description: Checks if the file is compressed.

methods.name: File::IsEncrypted
methods.description: Checks if the file is encrypted.

methods.name: File::Size
methods.description: Returns the size of the file.

methods.name: File::Move
methods.description: Moves the file to a new location.

methods.name: File::FileName
methods.description: Extracts filename without extension.

methods.name: File::FileNameExtended
methods.description: Extracts filename with extension.

methods.name: File::PathName
methods.description: Gets the directory path of the file.

methods.name: File::Extension
methods.description: Gets the file extension.

methods.name: Directory::CreatePath
methods.description: Creates the directory path.

methods.name: Directory::Create
methods.description: Creates the directory.

methods.name: Directory::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the directory handle is valid.

methods.name: Directory::Next
methods.description: Iterates to the next directory entry.

methods.name: Directory::Current
methods.description: Returns the current directory entry.

methods.name: Directory::Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the directory.

methods.name: Directory::Reset
methods.description: Resets directory enumeration.
